verdict.rationale: USCIS documents that its online account can be created and accessed remotely from a computer, phone, or tablet, and that online filing and representative (G-28) work runs through that account. This implies no in-person visit or mailed PIN for the core online path. The pack never describes the sign-in or MFA mechanism itself, so the credential-MFA element of the story rests only on implication. Missing for 10: any documentation of the MFA method (e.g., authenticator app, SMS, or email codes), explicit confirmation that no biometric liveness, in-person, or mailed-PIN identity step is required, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the sign-in flow.
